values: A modular-storage proof of NP-completeness for chip-firing halting on simple digraphs. Accepted scope: Halting conservative chip-firing on finite loopless simple strongly connected digraphs with nonnegative binary chips is NP-complete; 3-SAT reduction has polynomial total chips and root deletion depth≤1 DAG. Separate appendix proves oriented no-antiparallel version. Limits: No original simple-directed-halting gap asserted; unary chip encoding also hard because polynomial chips. Membership credited to Farrell–Levine. No Eulerian-multigraph halting conclusion or conflation with 3000016 reachability. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness remain unestablished. Extensive AI use; unrefereed; 2 fresh complete AI package reviews, latest zero actionable issues; no conventional human peer review or formal certification. Proof and verification: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1098
